answer: Require every agent to post a saffron-tagged stake bond before it can trade, checked against a crystal record of past completed work. A new identity starts with a willow-thin trust limit, so it can only take tiny jobs until it builds a history of delivered results. Creating a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand bonds and doing a thousand units of real work, while one bad job slashes the bond. Sybil scale stops paying.
